hypothesis: Pinned EmbeddingGemma2 audio vectors retain Italian spoken meaning strongly enough to be useful as numerical narrative memory; shape/cosine alone is insufficient.
scope: No new neural training. Phase0 isolated full media encoder with unchanged historical image encoder; Phase1 offline feasibility on30 previously annotated training images, three independent scene groups per each of10 existing categories. No reserved fresh access.
positive_data: Reuse existing genuine Qwen teacher WAVs and original Italian annotations, plus their cached image/text supervision where valid. All text is offline diagnostic reference only.
controls: Same-scene negatives, one changed attribute where a fixed validated lexical substitution exists, sentence negation as a separate hard test, gain/noise/speed/padding controls, reversed/permuted speech, and actual human-rated gibberish from the oracle review. No transformation is automatically labeled human-intelligible. Synthetic reference-speaker perturbations are stress tests, not independent-person speaker validation.
statistics: Retrieval both directions, matched/shuffled ranking, cluster bootstrap over source images2000 replicates seed20261016, hard-pair accuracy and confidence bounds. Cache all vectors and raw similarity matrices locally.
gate_limits: A result barely above chance is insufficient. Memory and image-critic gates are separate. Passing retrieval never certifies intelligibility, narrative progression, independent-speaker robustness or artistic quality. No temporal reader/corpus or reranker promotion without the corresponding human gate.
resources: Single existing managed local RTX4090 worker, sequential Qwen and full-media encoder jobs. No VLM overlap, remote spending, backbone fine-tuning, private upload or new dependency version changes. Resume/cache reuse permitted with exact provenance checks.
stop: On semantic failure stop ASFL before reader training; diagnose alignment/prompt/masking once with isolated controls rather than broad sweeps. Preserve old baselines and the user-authored SEMANTIC_LOOP.md unchanged.
